title: Use a label to display a small amount of text that people don’t need to edit

statement.en: Use a label for a small amount of text that people don't need to edit.
statement.ja: 利用者が編集する必要のない少量のtextにはlabelを使う。

conditions: Use the separate text-field or text-view rules when the amount or editability differs.
